entries.headline: ‘DepEd budget insufficient to address classroom shortage’
entries.summary_en: Education Secretary Sonny Angara said the Department of Education does not have enough funds to address the classroom shortage nationwide.
entries.summary_tl: Sinabi ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara na kulang ang pondo ng DepEd para tugunan ang kakulangan ng silid-aralan sa buong bansa.
entries.image_alt_en: Screenshot of the Philippine Star article headline and opening paragraph.
entries.image_alt_tl: Screenshot ng headline at unang talata ng artikulo ng Philippine Star.

entries.headline: Insufficient funds for new classrooms amid high budget, low utilization
entries.summary_en: Billions of pesos are allocated every year for classrooms and school buildings, yet the article reports a low utilization rate of these funds while the Secretary calls the budget insufficient.
entries.summary_tl: Bilyon-bilyong piso ang inilalaan taon-taon para sa mga silid-aralan at gusali ng paaralan, pero ayon sa artikulo ay mababa ang paggamit sa pondong ito habang sinasabi ng Kalihim na kulang ang budget.
entries.image_alt_en: Screenshot of the article's byline, date and opening paragraphs.
entries.image_alt_tl: Screenshot ng byline, petsa at unang mga talata ng artikulo.

entries.headline: P1.015 trillion DepEd budget for 2026: Where the money goes
entries.summary_en: DepEd allocated ₱19.51 billion for textbooks and other instructional materials (up from ₱12.41 billion the year before) and aims to procure 103.93 million learning materials in 2026.
entries.summary_tl: Naglaan ang DepEd ng ₱19.51 bilyon para sa textbook at iba pang learning materials (mula ₱12.41 bilyon noong nakaraang taon) at layong bumili ng 103.93 milyong learning materials sa 2026.
entries.image_alt_en: Screenshot of the budget figures for textbooks and learning materials.
entries.image_alt_tl: Screenshot ng budget para sa textbook at learning materials.

entries.headline: COA: DepEd did not use ₱14.5B fund on computerization, hiring of teachers
entries.summary_en: The Commission on Audit found that about ₱14.5 billion of DepEd's 2022 budget for computerization, equipment, facilities and hiring was not used, including about ₱9.1 billion for the Computerization Program.
entries.summary_tl: Ayon sa COA, humigit-kumulang ₱14.5 bilyon ng 2022 budget ng DepEd para sa computerization, kagamitan, pasilidad at pag-hire ang hindi nagamit, kasama ang mga ₱9.1 bilyon para sa Computerization Program.

entries.headline: COA: DepEd bought ₱2.4 billion worth of pricey, outdated laptops for teachers in 2021
entries.summary_en: The Commission on Audit flagged a ₱2.4 billion purchase of laptops for teachers in 2021 as overpriced and outdated, saying the higher price meant fewer teachers received laptops.
entries.summary_tl: Pinuna ng COA ang ₱2.4 bilyong pagbili ng laptop para sa mga guro noong 2021 dahil mahal at luma na ang mga ito, kaya mas kaunting guro ang nabigyan.
